children: up 5.1% post-market Wednesday following a Bloomberg report that the energy pipeline company is in the early stages of exploring options, including a potential sale.

The company is working with advisors to prepare for a potential sale process that could start within weeks, although no final decision has been made and it could decide to remain independent, according to the report.
controls a large network of gas gathering and processing infrastructure in the Permian Basin and has crude oil and water-gathering assets.
